import 'dart:math' as math;

void use(List<int> items, Future<void> Function(int) operation, int n) {
  final cap = math.min(1, n);
  // ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-dart
  mapWithConcurrency(items, operation, maxConcurrency: 1);
  // ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-dart
  mapWithConcurrency(items, operation, max_concurrency: 1);
  // ok: serial-bounded-helper-dart
  mapWithConcurrency(items, math.min(1, n), operation);
  // ok: serial-bounded-helper-dart
  mapWithConcurrency(items, math.min(n, 1), operation);
  // ok: serial-bounded-helper-dart
  mapWithConcurrency(items, cap, operation);
  mapWithConcurrency(items, operation, maxConcurrency: 4);
  mapWithConcurrency(items, operation, maxConcurrency: n);
  mapWithConcurrency(items, math.min(4, n), operation);
  mapWithConcurrency(items, math.max(1, n), operation);
  mapWithConcurrency(items, n + 1, operation);
  mapWithConcurrency(items, math.min(4, n + 1), operation);
}
